scope: Offline inspection of exact frozen API source and frontend mensaje; no database access or runtime execution

findings.detail: E11SessionProvider polls identity every 15 seconds with retry disabled and replaces business children on identity error. REVISION_OBSOLETA is mapped by E11 for 40001, 40P01 and 23505, not an inventory scan response code. This establishes an independent route to the observed full-page failure, not proof that any one failed identity request caused the reported duplicate-scan screenshot.

requireSession performs a session expiry UPDATE before awaiting e11AuthIdentity. E11 identity transactions hold FOR SHARE locks on user and session rows; e11Execute also uses SERIALIZABLE for its work transaction. Concurrent sliding-expiry updates and login last-access updates can wait for these locks. Middleware expiry UPDATE completes outside the identity transaction: its source alone does not establish a session-update/identity lock cycle.

E11 work and delivery reauthorization use two sequential awaited transactions, not nested transactions. e11Runtime passes the transaction handle into work. These paths do not themselves demonstrate pool self-starvation. The exact frozen pool defaults are max 30, acquisition timeout 5000 ms, server statement timeout 30000 ms and client query timeout 35000 ms; deployed environment overrides were not inspected.

Supplied connection-acquisition and query timeouts support resource pressure and/or long waits. They do not establish a PostgreSQL deadlock, a serialization rollback, missing clone catalogs, permission-policy defects, or a particular endpoint implementation error. No 40001/40P01 evidence was supplied. Failure to update user/session rows can occur before the authorization rejection, explaining why an otherwise forbidden route may return an infrastructure error without granting access.

decision.identitySerializationRetry: not implemented: no demonstrated serialization failure, and retries on connection/query timeout could amplify exhaustion
decision.inventoryPieza: outside this task; existing separate three-file overlay unchanged

nextEvidenceRequiredAfterExclusiveWindow: MAIN correlates request IDs/timestamps of identity failures with duplicate-scan browser evidence and safe SQLSTATE classifications.
On isolated database only, owner captures pool total/idle/waiting counts and sanitized pg_stat_activity wait types plus pg_blocking_pids during the reproduction; no SQL parameters or credentials.

Determine whether connection holders are blocked by database locks, slow queries, external contention, or unreleased clients. Verify runtime timeout/pool settings without disclosing connection strings.

If an actual read-only identity transaction returns 40001 or 40P01, consider bounded whole-transaction retry only after successful rollback, with fresh authorization on every attempt and no retry of writes, delivery failures, dependency timeouts or ambiguous outcomes.
Do not patch the global provider to retain sensitive children on identity failure or bypass identity checks; do not return fabricated successful prices/history/payment results.
